description.text: This program is based on the basic requirements of training objectives for undergraduate international students majoring in dental surgery in China. According to the requirements of international education in dental surgery, it aims to cultivate high-level dental professionals who master basic knowledge, theories, skills of basic medicine and clinical medicine, and are able to adapt to the demands of international dental talent market, pass the dental licensing examination in their respective countries, and engage in dental medical treatment and preventive health care.

duration.text: The Bachelor of Dental Surgery at Ningxia Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 400 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4138 USD/per year ￥ 29800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.The photocopy of passport;2.ID photo with white background;3.Highest degree certificate and transcript (English version);4.Physical Examination Record for Foreigner;5.Non-criminal Record (issued by the local police station);6.Financial Guarantee Letter (the certificate of bank saving)/ Bank statement.*You will be notified If additional materials are required.

requirements.text: 1.Non-Chinese citizen with valid foreign passport;2.Age under 25;3.In good physical and mental health (Note:BDS program does not admit left-handed students);4.Qualified with a high school degree or above or K12 grade(10+2) or equivalent academic ability; English, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology courses have passed the graduation exams of the student's country (at least B/70).
